method: claude CLI as MCP client, /private/tmp/uv2/mcp.json (four servers as node servers/<name>/dist/index.js), --strict-mcp-config --model sonnet --max-turns 12 --allowedTools "mcp__*", fresh XDG_DATA_HOME=/private/tmp/uv2/data + XDG_CONFIG_HOME=/private/tmp/uv2/cfg (free tier). stream-json transcripts kept so tool calls are countable. pt1b control adds --disallowedTools "WebFetch,WebSearch,Bash,Read,Write,Edit". Same 14 prompts and same sales.xlsx fixture (title row + blank + header row 3, 400 data rows rebuilt from the round-1 record set, sheets Sales/Reps/Notes).

scenarios.prompt: Start tracking time for the Acme website project.
Stop the timer and tell me how long I worked.

delta.why: unchanged, 8 s / 0.00 h, correct for real elapsed time.

scenarios.prompt: Log 2.5 hours yesterday for Acme, design review, at 90 euros an hour.
scenarios.note: entry_add {project:"Acme", rate:"90 euros an hour"} -> resolved to the existing "Acme website" project, answer 'EUR 90/h = EUR 225.00'.

delta.why: D-3 and D-7 fixed in the model's answer: currency parsed from the words, project name reconciled.

scenarios.prompt: How much do I bill Acme this week? Give me invoice lines.
scenarios.note: EUR 90.00/h, EUR 225.00, 2.50 h, single project. Correct. But invoice_summary (the tool the prompt names) is Pro-gated, so the model rebuilt the lines from entry_list + report over 7 calls and 35.6 s.

delta.why: currency and split-project defects gone (numbers now right), but a new friction replaces them: the paywalled invoice_summary costs 7 calls where 1 would do.

scenarios.prompt: What does this cost right now: https://books.toscrape.com/catalogue/a-light-in-the-attic_1000/index.html
scenarios.note: Client answered with built-in WebFetch again. The rewritten price_check description was never read: the model ran ToolSearch "select:WebFetch" directly.

delta.why: D-4 not fixed from the user's point of view. Better descriptions cannot win a selection the model never opens.

scenarios.note: price_check -> GBP 51.77, plus 'Confidence: low (regex-fallback)', which the model relayed.

delta.why: ceiling unchanged; confidence line is new and was surfaced to the user.

scenarios.prompt: Watch that page and alert me if it goes under 40.
scenarios.note: watch_add succeeded and the model told the user, unprompted, that nothing polls in the background and that 'refresh my watches' is the pattern. No external scheduler was invoked.

delta.why: D-5 fixed: the honesty text stopped the agent building a cron job.

scenarios.prompt: Show me everything I'm watching and whether anything dropped.
scenarios.note: watch_refresh {all:true} then watch_list then alerts_pending, all free. Answer: GBP 51.77, +0.00%, target GBP 40 not hit, confidence low.

delta.why: alerts_pending is free now, so the second half of the question is answerable.

scenarios.prompt: Open sales.xlsx and tell me what's in it.

delta.why: unchanged: 3 sheets, 400 rows, header row found past the title+blank preamble.

scenarios.prompt: Which rep sold the most units in the North region? Top 5 with totals.
scenarios.note: One sheet_query with group_by+aggregate did the work in-server (no python), but the model added an unrequested [Status]="Closed" filter and reported Turing 391, Linus 334, Hopper 311, Lovelace 173, Liskov 156. Ground truth for the question asked is Turing 650, Hopper 567, Linus 551, Lovelace 486, Liskov 290. Top rep right, totals and 2nd/3rd order wrong. The same query without the Closed filter returns the ground truth exactly in one call (verified by direct probe).

delta.why: D-6 is fixed in the server (aggregation in one call, 71.4 s -> 23.0 s, no Bash fallback) but the user's answer got worse: the model narrowed the question on its own and the numbers no longer match ground truth.

scenarios.prompt: Add a Revenue column and save it as a CSV next to the original.
scenarios.note: sheet_add_column wrote /private/tmp/uv2/sales.csv: 401 lines (header + 400 rows), Revenue matches ground truth on every row, total 10,142,542.04. String prices ('1,516.16' x 35 = 53065.6) handled. Source xlsx untouched.

delta.why: D-1 fixed: the 500-row cap lets a 400-row file through whole, so no truncated-but-plausible file and no python fallback.

scenarios.prompt: Set up my business: ... EUR, 23% VAT, 14 day terms.

delta.why: unchanged, every field parsed from free text in one call.

scenarios.prompt: Invoice Acme, 12 h API work at 90 EUR + 300 EUR setup, PDF.
scenarios.note: INV-2026-0001, EUR 1080.00 + EUR 300.00 = EUR 1380.00, 23% tax EUR 317.40, total EUR 1697.40. Exact. The model also relayed the new bare-client warning and offered client_add.

delta.why: same score; D-8's address warning now reaches the user in prose.

scenarios.prompt: Which invoices are unpaid and overdue?
scenarios.note: overdue_report answered directly on free, one call, no fallback.

price_hits.note: REFUSED as intended: redirected to /us/en/cat/billy-bookcases-58288/, 'it is a "cat" listing page'. Round 1 returned USD 39 from that listing. D-2 fixed.

FALSE REFUSAL (D-9). The extractor read USD 469 from the correct product page; checkRedirect rejected the SEO-slug canonical redirect /p/<id> -> /<slug>/p/<id> as 'path depth changed from 2 to 3 segments'. Round 1 scored this correct.

pdf.detail: A4 single page from INV-2026-0001, pdftoppm -png -r 80. Every amount carries the currency code: UNIT 'EUR 90.00' / 'EUR 300.00', AMOUNT 'EUR 1080.00' / 'EUR 300.00', 'Subtotal EUR 1380.00', 'Tax 23% on EUR 1380.00  EUR 317.40', 'Total EUR 1697.40'. Nothing clipped, nothing overlapping, columns still aligned with the wider money strings. Remaining cosmetic gap: BILL TO is still the bare name 'Acme' (auto-created client), but the tool response now warns about it and names the fix.

limits_hit.note: New in round 2's reading: with the other three Pro walls removed, this is the one that still costs the user calls. 7 calls / 35.6 s to rebuild the answer from free tools.

no_longer_hit: spreadsheet 200-row write cap (now 500 and refuses rather than truncating)
free_tier.upgrade_message_verdict: Unchanged and clear. Names the feature, $19 / $39 lifetime bundle, checkout URL, activation step, offline verification.

D-1.evidence: ss3: 401-line CSV, all 400 rows, revenue exact, one call, no fallback.

D-2.evidence: IKEA price_check now errors with the listing-page refusal instead of returning USD 39.

D-3.evidence: tt3 answered EUR 90.00/h -> EUR 225.00; tt4 printed EUR 225.00, no '$' anywhere.

D-4.evidence: pt1 still answered by WebFetch; price_check never called.

D-5.evidence: pt2 stated no background polling and named watch_refresh; no scheduler skill invoked.

D-6.evidence: one in-server group_by+sum call, 71.4 s -> 23.0 s, no python; but the model's self-added Closed filter made the reported totals wrong (see D-10).

D-7.evidence: tt3 'Acme' resolved to 'Acme website'; tt4 billed one project, not two.

D-8.evidence: PDF carries EUR on every line amount; iv2 relayed the missing-address warning and the client_add fix.

new_defects.title: checkRedirect false-positives on slug-canonicalisation redirects
new_defects.repro: node probe.mjs price-tracker '{"name":"price_check","args":{"url":"https://www.newegg.com/p/N82E16819113877"}}' -> Error: 'the path depth changed from 2 to 3 segments'. The final URL is the same product (/<slug>/p/N82E16819113877) and the extractor read USD 469 from it.
new_defects.fix_direction: before the depth rule, accept a redirect whose final path still contains every non-generic segment of the request (here the product id N82E16819113877), or whose final path is the request path plus a leading slug.

new_defects.title: aggregate query answers a narrower question than the user asked
new_defects.repro: ss2 prompt -> model issued where '[Region] = "North" AND [Status] = "Closed"' and reported Turing 391 rather than 650. Server is correct: the same query without the Status filter returns Turing 650, Hopper 567, Linus 551, Lovelace 486, Liskov 290.
new_defects.fix_direction: sheet_query's group header line already says 'N groups from X of 400 rows'; have it also echo the where clause, so an unrequested filter is visible in the model's answer.

new_defects.title: invoice_summary Pro-gate is the last paywall that costs a free user real work
new_defects.repro: node probe.mjs time-tracker '{"name":"invoice_summary","args":{"project":"Acme website","from":"2026-08-31","to":"2026-09-02"}}' -> upgrade text. servers/time-tracker/src/index.ts:701.
new_defects.fix_direction: free for a single project or a 7-day window, Pro for multi-project / arbitrary ranges, matching the treatment given to alerts_pending and overdue_report.

totals.hit_rate_note: 5 of 12 correct in both rounds, but a different 5: IKEA moved from wrong-price to correctly-refused, Newegg moved from correct to falsely-refused, Allegro 403 -> timeout. Pages that returned usable HTML: 6 of 12; of those, 5 correct, 1 falsely refused.
